projects.title: MyPathMapping
projects.description:
Web application that shows the difference in access to quality financial services for low income youth

●  Integrated Mapbox API and Geocoder RubyGem to geocode the locations of the user entered data
●  Collected census data from through their provided GIS shapefile to map the relationship between predatory financial services and low-income and minority districts in San Francisco
●  Built custom API endpoints in Rails that returned bank and predatory financial service locations
●  Designed schema for a PostgreSQL database to create relationships between NPOs and their regional data
●  Used BCrypt for authentication as a means to encrypt NPOs user password before storing it in the database
●  Communicated directly with client to identify their needs and specific features required in the application

projects.title: I-Tinnity
projects.description:
Integrate 2015 Hackathon sponsor winner for:
●  1st place from Soleo
●  2nd place from Traitify
●  2nd place from JustAPI

I-Tinnity is a web platform to generate personalized vacation itineraries in munutes based on user personality and desired vacation theme

● Leveraged Soleo and Sabre APIs to assemble a list of local business based on a specific vacation destination

● Created component-driven Meteor frontend to display personality test, results, and related
recommendations
